name: bottleneck gap
note: Narrow center crossing. Only one robot in the gap at a time. Do not wait at 0,0.

name: west station
note: West aisle landmark, not a parking goal. West spawns are at x=-10, y=±2/±6 — do not send crossed robots onto those poses.

name: east station
note: East aisle landmark, not a parking goal. East spawns are at x=10, y=±2/±6 — do not send crossed robots onto those poses.

name: west parking south
note: Goal for a robot that started on the EAST. Behind west spawns (x=-10). One robot only. Approach along y≈-11, not along the spawn column.

name: west parking center
note: Goal for a robot that started on the EAST. Back wall, behind station_west. One robot only. Do not stop on west spawn poses.

name: west parking north
note: Goal for a robot that started on the EAST. Behind west spawns (x=-10). One robot only. Approach along y≈11, not along the spawn column.

name: east parking south
note: Goal for a robot that started on the WEST. Behind east spawns (x=10). One robot only. Approach along y≈-11, not along the spawn column.

name: east parking center
note: Goal for a robot that started on the WEST. Back wall, behind station_east. One robot only. Do not stop on east spawn poses.

name: east parking north
note: Goal for a robot that started on the WEST. Behind east spawns (x=10). One robot only. Approach along y≈11, not along the spawn column.
